data.one_liner: Reactive key-value storage powered by RxDart
data.what_it_does: Provides a reactive key-value storage wrapper for Dart and Flutter using RxDart streams to observe changes. It supports custom storage adapters, encoders, decoders, and in-memory persistence.
use_when: You need to observe specific storage keys as streams in a reactive architecture
You want an RxDart-powered storage layer in your Dart or Flutter application
avoid_when: You need multi-key transactions or complex relational SQL features
You prefer standard Futures and do not use RxDart or streams
strengths: Reactive stream support for observing individual keys or all entries
Customizable encoders and decoders for synchronous and asynchronous operations
weaknesses: Direct adapter changes or changes through other wrappers are not observed
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart SDK >=3.0.0 <4.0.0. Add via pub add rx_storage.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the standard, official key-value storage solution for simple preferences without RxDart overhead.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a relational SQLite database rather than a simple key-value store.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to store sensitive data securely using platform-specific secure hardware storage.
